messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION eu-west-1 - queue_growth=+420% in 5m, pool_util=98%, pending_requests=14k. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood/internal/alert/2367890123 :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: on it. taking pager. hopping into infra console now.

jordan_sre: pinging -- I can help run quick triage and coordinate mitigations. Is this across all GPU pools in eu-west or single pool?

mike_oncall: looks concentrated on pool "eu-west-ml-g4" per the console. other pools steady at ~70%.

priya_prodeng: important: customer-facing latencies for /v1/generate are spiking. support queue is getting notes from key accounts. tagging @customer_ops.

customer_ops: seeing increased P50 and P99 on hosted API, several 503s reported. Marking customers A/B/C affected. We'll prepare comms if mitigation is >30m.

alex_infra: quick data point: autoscaler didn't kick beyond 64 nodes due to scale_limit config (max_nodes=64) and provider quota for that AZ is 70. It hit the soft limit and backoff triggered.

chris_ml: could be model selection pressure - some routes pinned to larger variants. Might reduce pressure by routing non-critical traffic to smaller quantized models.

mike_oncall: action plan attempt 1: (1) enable reserved burst capacity for eu-west (temporary +8 nodes) (2) enable graceful-throttle on non-SLAs (3) reroute low-priority routes to smaller model variants. Assigning owners below.

jordan_sre: I can run the burst capacity command. running cloud-provider override now:```bash
# override to request 8 extra nodes
cloudctl compute request --region eu-west --pool eu-west-ml-g4 --add-nodes 8 --reason "incident 2367890123"
```

alex_infra: +1. also opening provider support ticket in parallel in case quota bump needed. ticket id: CP-44291.

mike_oncall: priya, can you confirm which routes are low priority so we can flip routing rules?

priya_prodeng: low-pri: /v1/embeddings-bulk, /v1/debug-sim, /v1/internal-eval. non-customer-facing. We should also throttle background batch jobs.

chris_ml: I'll push a quick routing change to send those to quant-4 (smaller) models. Doing a canary 5% first.

mike_oncall: note: enabling graceful-throttle policy now -> will shed 30% of requests from non-SLA routes. Doing config toggle:```json
{
  "policy": "graceful-throttle",
  "scope": "non_sla_routes",
  "drop_fraction": 0.3
}
```

jordan_sre: burst nodes coming up, saw 6/8 become Ready in 90s. pending 2 due to image pull. monitoring queue length. pending_requests trending down from 14k -> 6.2k.

tara_support: customers updated: posted to status page that we're experiencing capacity constraints in eu-west, mitigation in progress. Keeping customers informed every 15m.

customer_ops: received confirmation from 2 enterprise customers that traffic rerouting helped their endpoints, others still seeing errors.

alex_infra: provider ticket responded: quota bump approved for eu-west AZ to 80 nodes but provisioning will take ~8-12m. I'll keep the ticket open.

mike_oncall: good. next: ensure no regressions from routing change. chris, how's canary?

chris_ml: canary at 5% for 3m. latency OK for canary. increasing to 20% now.

jordan_sre: queue now ~2.1k pending. token throughput increased. autoscaler backoff flags cleared after manual override.

priya_prodeng: support notes: some customers saw degraded quality when sent to quantized models. Log customer IDs for follow-up: CUST-114, CUST-198. We'll coordinate post-incident evaluation.

mike_oncall: short-term status: mitigations effective, pool util down to 74%, pending_requests 900. Keeping incident open until metrics stable for 30m.

incidents-bot: NOTE: incident status changed -> Mitigation initiated by manual burst + routing changes. Severity -> Sev2.

jordan_sre: proposed immediate postmortem action items (quick list):
- remove hard autoscaler max_nodes=64 for this pool; use provider soft quota with alerting
- add backstop that allows emergency-burst > quota when approved by oncall (audit log required)
- implement preemptive re-routing during scale events for non-SLA traffic
- add model-routing fallback to smaller variants for non-critical routes

priya_prodeng: also adding product action: add customer-visible config for preferred fallback models per org so quality is preserved for key accounts.

alex_infra: infra actions: check image-pull timeouts on new nodes (we saw 2 stall). Add parallel image prefetch to speed burst provisioning.

mike_oncall: assigning owners: jordan -> infra autoscale config; alex -> provider quota playbook & prefetch; chris -> routing/fallback tests; priya -> customer follow-up & comms; tara -> incident write-up draft.

tara_support: starting incident summary draft. Will include timelines, affected customers, and interim mitigations. ETA 45m for a first pass.

mike_oncall: final update for now: sustained recovery. keeping monitoring window open for 30m. If anything spikes, re-alert in this thread. Thanks all for fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

customer_ops: will schedule customer outreach and capture any SLA impact for billing/credits reviews.

incidents-bot: Incident 2367890123 -> Mitigation complete -> metrics stable for 35m. Closing pager. Please file postmortem with assigned action items within 72h.

mike_oncall: noted. I'll own the postmortem runbook and coordinate follow-ups.
